name: dsh-spiral
description: SemanticNebula (语义星云) — decorative DSH / DeepSeek Harness plugin: every prompt becomes a rotating four-arm spiral nebula with a local semantic footprint map. No model, no network, under 130 KB.
author: songzhou666

summary.en: A decorative DSH Web GUI plugin that turns every submitted prompt into a slowly rotating four-arm spiral nebula, with a local semantic footprint map beside it. No network, no model, no message access; client bundle under 130 KB.
summary.zh: 纯装饰性 DSH Web GUI 插件：把每条提示词实时投影成一片会自转的四臂旋涡星云，并在旁边绘制本地语义足迹图。不联网、不调模型、不读取消息内容，客户端产物小于 130 KB。

capabilities: Live prompt-to-nebula projection using deterministic local hashing
Semantic footprint map with history trail and coordinate grid
Draggable, resizable 520 x 352 panel following host light and dark themes
Semantic roaming playback for prompts and model answers
Three colour schemes with parallax, ripples and reduced-motion support
Zero runtime dependencies, zero network calls, client bundle under 130 KB
